label: end-of-episode timer (last ~10 trials, low value), GO and D2 steps
explanation: Fires only late in the episode: 0 activations before trial 79, 3.5% rate in trials 80-89, 49% in trials 90-99 (96% of mass). Equivalently it tracks the model value head falling at the end of the finite episode (value < 5.22, bottom ~10% of steps, holds 99% of mass). Within that period it fires on GO (65% of mass) and D2 (31%), rarely on D1. Magnitude grows toward episode end and is larger when the agent chooses a2 / good=S2 (lift 1.2x for a2; action==2 restriction hurts recall). Does not depend on reward, transition or stay/switch pattern. Score with ep_trial>=90 & phase!=D1 is similar (F1 0.74); a tighter value<4.5 gives higher precision (0.82) but lower mass recall (0.87). Precision ~0.67 because not every late GO/D2 step crosses threshold. Uses no future variables (value is the model output; the episode clock is not an input but the agent can integrate time).
